row.description: An International Registration Data Identifier used to identify standardized product-data dictionary concepts in IEC 61360 and related industrial classification systems.

neighbors.description: A related identifier whose registry body may use another registered prefix.
A product-classification identifier that commonly uses the same IRDI family of syntax.

row.wrong_generalization: Treating the hyphens and number signs as decorative punctuation would wrongly accept reordered segments, omitted separators, or arbitrary UUID-like identifiers.

row.description: A STEP physical-file entity instance reference consisting of a number sign followed by a positive integer, used to link CAD and product-model entities.

neighbors.description: The named EXPRESS entity type following an instance name in a STEP physical file.
A positional value inside an aggregate, not a globally referable entity instance name.

row.wrong_generalization: Three-digit samples can look fixed-width, but STEP instance numbers are variable-width positive integers; padding them or limiting them to three digits would reject valid large models.
